exposure: labor induction method (dinoprostone or oxytocin administration)
cohort: The study included 254 patients with a cephalic fetal presentation admitted for labor induction at >=41 0/7 weeks of gestation in a tertiary center.
finding: The study found a high cesarean section rate during labor induction in low-risk, late-term cephalic pregnancies, with nulliparity and male fetal sex identified as risk factors for cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: The overall cesarean section rate during labor induction was 28.7%, being significantly higher in nulliparous women (44.3%) compared to multiparous women (14.4%), and nulliparity and male fetal sex were associated with cesarean delivery.
